profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Bryn Neil International
profile.summary: Results-driven software developer with 10 years of experience in multiple development frameworks, including React, Angular, Java, and JavaScript. Expertise in building robust, scalable applications and enhancing system performance. Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies quickly and a strong interest in quantum computing and its potential to revolutionize problem-solving. Actively pursuing opportunities to apply software development skills to quantum algorithms and applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed front-end applications hosted on Amazon S3 with static website confiurations, and orchestrated infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation.
• Integrated dynamic application data via AWS DyanmoDB, AWS Lambda, and API Gateway, enabling scalable and serverless architecture patterns.
• Utilized end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with Gradle, Jenkins, and Artifactory, automating builds and deployments to AWS environments..
• Spearheaded frontend codebase standardization efforts, ensuring modular, reusable, and testable components that align with modern software practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Vue.js · DevOps · Amazon S3 · Cloud Applications

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed dynamic web applications using React with Redux and Redux Toolkit (RTK), enhancing state management and improving user experience across multiple projects, with a focus on frontend microservices architecture.
- Collaborated on AI-driven projects, utilizing Azure Cognitive Services to incorporate machine learning features, enhancing application functionality and user engagement.
- Utilized C# to develop the new (IC3) Internet Crime Complaint Center government site.
- Leveraged Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines, streamlining deployment processes and ensuring high-quality code through automated testing and continuous integration.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Microsoft Azure · Redux.js · C#

positions.title: Software/Web Developer Level 3
positions.description:
•	Supported the J2-3/Joint Chief Staff(The Chairman) within the Pentagon
•	Developed the new J2 Partner Page, a single-page application to coexist within the Source.
•	Implemented HTTP requests using RxJS Observable library to handle multiple values over time.
•	Used AJAX, JSON with jQuery for request data and response processing.
•	Extensive experience working under Agile methodologies environment (scrum, Kanban)

positions.title: Lead Technologist
positions.description:
•	Experience in Developing User Interface (UI) Rich Web Applications, and Web Service Applications using Front End/User Interface (UI) Technologies like Object Oriented JavaScript, Type Script, Angular 2.0, Angular 4, Angular JS, Node JS, Vue JS, Bootstrap, Media Queries, CSS Frameworks.
•	Work in Test Driven Development environment, leveraging QA automation test suite to provide unit tests and integration tests for all new functionality.
•	Experience with various IDE’s such as Visual Studio Code, Web Strom, Sublime and Notepad++.
•	Managed GitHub repositories and permissions, including branching and tagging

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed an Acquisition Submission/Tracking tool for documenting the acquisition process.
- Built ASP webpages utilizing code behind, web methods, and Ajax calls.
- Designed, built, managed and operated the continuous delivery framework and tools, as well as SME on specific tools.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and Maintained new APIs for integration with multiple reporting tools, ex. Splunk..
•	Designed and developed front-end for 20+ websites with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript frameworks and libraries to implement enterprise-class web applications.
•	Developed RESTful API’s to communicate device data digested into various platforms across Government
•	Developed a Network Monitoring Service currently being utilized by multiple branches of Government *Live Map*

positions.title: Service Desk Analyst
positions.description:
Department of State, Rosslyn, Va. (Contract)

Maintained records using the Remedy Tracking system on calls received, customers supported, service level agreements, performance statistics, and any other information necessary for accurate customer billing or reporting as required by the Government.
Assisted the user in the general usage and operation of the LAN and workstations as well as in the use of various software applications.
Assisted in mining data from the SQL database, and in offering support to other personnel who required to access and analyze the SQL database.
Diagnosed, troubleshot and resolved a range of software, hardware and connectivity issues. Excelled in asking probing questions and researching, analyzing and rectifying problems.

positions.title: Fiber Customer Support Analyst
positions.description:
Provided customers with service activation support for Data service PC configuration, home router configuration, and/or email/internet applications.
Performed analysis, and isolation of trouble conditions, and provided trouble resolution and closeout.
Sorted troubles into User, Voice Network, and Data Network, Video Network & OS Plant categories.
Provided Home Network Equipment Support to customers.
Use diagnostic tools to troubleshoot problems associated with network connectivity.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description:
-Department Of Defense SECRET Clearance (Active) (Willing to be sponsored for a TS/SCI).
-Maintain, repair, calibrate, tune, and adjust all electronic equipment used for communications, detection and tracking.
-Handle classified documents.
-Train naval personnel in security procedures.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Technician
positions.description:
-Provided support for a variety of proprietary government applications.
-Exceeded various service levels (SLAs) as established by assignment (calls per day, ETAs, on- time response, administrative call closure, customer satisfaction).
-Developed and created documentation on training materials, FAQs and Knowledge Base Articles
-Performed closed-loop communication with end users to resolution

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Develop a one to one relationship with a youth by offering consistency, encouragement, and role modeling.
-To develop a friendship with this child through simple, sharing activities.

"The grass isn't always greener on the other side." This volunteer work made me realize that no matter how gloom a situation i'm in may feel, there are people in worse positions. Being a role model figure for those elementary school kids, and interacting with them changed my life.
